evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (cargo 526 lib tests incl. 10 preparation::selection, integration tests incl. knowledge_deletion, bun, node, typecheck, gallery 150 passed); removing the eligibility check fails 2 selection tests

notes:
Did: migration 20261024000300_phase3_preparation_sources.sql: preparation_sources (planned_meeting_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, position, kind document|knowledge, document_version_id FK, meeting_id, knowledge_item_id; PK (planned_meeting_id, position); UNIQUE per plan on version and on item; CHECK that each kind fills exactly its columns). Module src/preparation/ with models.rs (SelectedSource enum, serde {kind:'document', versionId} | {kind:'knowledge', meetingId, itemId}; SelectionError codes PLANNED_MEETING_NOT_FOUND, SELECTION_TOO_LARGE, SELECTION_DUPLICATE_SOURCE, SOURCE_NOT_ELIGIBLE, PREPARATION_STORAGE_FAILED; caps MAX_SELECTED_DOCUMENT_VERSIONS 12 and MAX_SELECTED_KNOWLEDGE_ITEMS 60), selection.rs (select replaces the whole selection in input order and returns it; list returns it ordered by position), and commands.rs: prep_select_sources(plannedMeetingId, sources) -> SelectedSource[] and prep_list_sources(plannedMeetingId) -> SelectedSource[], registered in lib.rs. Knowledge eligibility is checked through KnowledgeRepository::list_eligible_items, called once per distinct meeting; an invalid or unknown meeting id gives SOURCE_NOT_ELIGIBLE, and a knowledge storage error gives PREPARATION_STORAGE_FAILED. A version of a deleted or unknown document gives SOURCE_NOT_ELIGIBLE (checked inside the write transaction). The caps and the duplicate check run before any read, so a refused selection leaves the saved one unchanged. 10 tests in preparation::selection. MeetingsRepository's MEETING_SCOPED_DELETE_ORDER now includes preparation_sources, so deleting a recorded meeting removes selections of its items. tests/knowledge_deletion.rs needs a row in every table with a meeting_id column, so it now inserts a planned meeting and a selection for meeting A. Both files were outside S1's touches.
Assumptions: the selection is saved whole (replace, not add or remove one entry). The same source twice is refused with SELECTION_DUPLICATE_SOURCE. list does not re-check eligibility: an item rejected or a document deleted after selection still lists; B1 must re-check eligibility when it builds context.
Learned: any new table with a column named meeting_id is picked up by tests/knowledge_deletion.rs, and must be added to MEETING_SCOPED_DELETE_ORDER in database/repositories/meeting.rs. Knowledge eligibility is read before the write transaction, because list_eligible_items takes a pool and the in-memory test pool has one connection, so a review change in between is not caught. Deleting a document does not remove its selection rows; they still name the version, which select then refuses.
